sections.content: When reporting a past conversation, adjust tense, pronouns and time or place expressions when the perspective requires it.

items.english: “I live here” → He said that he lived there.

items.spanish: «Mañana voy» → Dijo que al día siguiente iba.
items.english: “I am going tomorrow” → He said that he was going the next day.

items.spanish: «Estoy en mi habitación» → Dijo que estaba en su habitación.
items.english: “I am in my room” → He said that he was in his room.
